name: Duane G. Winn
office: Lancaster School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Duane G. Winn was appointed to the Lancaster School Board in 2016. He is a former air traffic controller and served in the military. His board page says his priority is to promote students' potential by including music, arts, and literature in their lives.

items.text: As board president in 2024, he and the board unanimously voted to place a school district bond on the November 2024 ballot.
